summary: Iteration 16: all requested features PASS. Backend 11/11 (test_iter16_hidden_filter.py): admin hidden_in=any returns exactly the DB set of products with non-empty hidden_city_ids (4), hidden_in=<city> returns only products hidden in that city (Borås 4, Göteborg 1 = 17211645, Stockholm/Malmö 0), unknown city -> 0, works with q search, works for both admins; customers: hidden_in ignored (same total as no param, no hidden_city_ids leaked, own-city hidden never returned); unauth 401. Frontend (375x667): admin card labels 'Dold i Borås' and 'Dold i Borås, Göteborg' (17211645); hidden-filter-toggle opens hidden-filter-dropdown with all/any/4 city options (48px rows), selecting filters list + closes dropdown + hidden-filter-value updates (Dolda i någon butik / Dolda i Göteborg / Dolda i Stockholm -> empty state), 'Alla artiklar' restores 1236. Customer sees no filter and no hidden labels. Cart: cart-size-<key> opens size-sheet with all 7 product sizes (current marked), M->S changes line key/size, S->L merges into existing L line (qty 2), scrim closes without change, persisted after reload. Regression: credits estimate 56 for 3x1899 kr unchanged after size-merge; cart-item-open opens /product/44062513?color=8953. No deprecated Expo packages.

minor.issue: Arbitrary/unknown city id is accepted and simply returns 0 items (no validation). Acceptable but could 400.

ui_bugs.issue: No error/empty state: if GET /products/{part_no} fails (e.g. product since hidden for the customer's city -> 404, or offline) or product has no sizes, the sheet shows only the title with an empty grid. Add q.isError / empty message.
Merged quantity is not clamped to 9999 like setQuantity does (cur.quantity + ex.quantity).

issues: Selected label for 'any' is 'Dolda i någon butik' while the option text is 'Alla dolda artiklar' – use the same wording.
Empty state when a city has no hidden articles says 'Prova en annan sökning, kategori eller färre filter.' – should say e.g. 'Inga dolda artiklar i Stockholm' with a 'Visa alla artiklar' action.
Header with gender toggle + search + category + hidden filter takes ~325px of 667px on small phones, leaving ~half the screen for the product grid (admin only).
